description: Opens one clue on a Plot Speaks trivia board and returns its text (not the answer). Category "final" opens the final once the board is clear. In a survey or letter game it deals the next question or puzzle: pass category "next" ("skip" gives the open one up; "no steal" closes a survey question after three strikes). In a timeline game it starts a round: pass the deck's name, then " for " and the players' names (the reply deals the first card); "next" repeats the open card. In Worms!, Yacht (and Pigs!) it sets up the game: pass "rules" for the how-to-play beats, or "players", the names and "and Wormbot" (Skipper in Yacht, Hambot in Pigs!) or "no CPU" ("play again" after a game).

category.description: The category the player picked, or "final" ("next" in a survey or letter game; the deck's name in a timeline game; "rules" or "players Ann, Bob and Wormbot" in Worms!)

value.description: The value the player picked, e.g. 300

name: game_question
title: Trivia clue
